title: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated in Python 3.12+
evidence: app.py:83,85,129,219 call datetime.utcnow(), which emits a DeprecationWarning on Python 3.12+; prefer datetime.now(timezone.utc)
suggestion: Use datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) and store timezone-aware ISO timestamps

title: init_db() runs as an import side effect on a hard-coded relative path
evidence: app.py:268 calls init_db() at module import time against DATABASE='books.db' (app.py:9), a CWD-relative file created wherever the process starts
suggestion: Guard DB init behind app factory / __main__ or make the path configurable via env var

title: No requirements.txt / pyproject.toml pinning dependencies
evidence: run_dir has no requirements.txt; README.md:26 documents `pip install flask pytest` prose-only, dependencies unpinned
suggestion: Add a requirements.txt pinning flask and pytest for reproducible setup

title: Whitespace-only title/author rejected on both create and update (beyond spec)
evidence: app.py:52-58 and app.py:211-214 strip and reject blank strings; exercised by test_app.py:307-404
suggestion: None — this is a robustness improvement over the minimal spec
